series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits an upward trend with moderate seasonality, but high noise and unstable model rankings indicate concept drift. A weighted combination with dynamic error adaptation is recommended to address performance drift and high variability.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to performance drift via exponential error weighting (Gaillard et al. 2015)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.top_k=4 AND recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35 → Inverse-RMSE weights with shrinkage balances model performance variation (Bates & Granger 1969)
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → Per-horizon selection captures differentiated model accuracy across forecast horizons (Timmermann 2006)
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.15: series_profile.noise.level=high AND model_landscape.rankings_stable=false → Trimmed mean mitigates outlier model influence in unstable rankings (Genre et al. 2013)

excluded_highlights.stl_hierarchical_stacking_p4_sh0.2: series_profile.model_landscape.models_redundant=false → STL decomposition assumes component redundancy not present here (Hyndman et al. 2011)
